samples.summary: Untrusted clipboard payload now triggers a document-wide style write pass
samples.evidence: `handlePaste` deserializes the attacker-influenceable WAFFLEDOCS_MIME payload (`deserializeClipboard`, sanitized in view/clipboard.ts) and then calls `this.doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll()` (text-editor.ts:1264), which walks every body, header, footer and nested table-cell block (model/document.ts `dropStaleStyleOffAll`) and can emit `store.applyStyles` edits for runs the paste never touched. A page that seeds the clipboard with many runs carrying `italic:false` in a block type whose named style does not supply it turns one user paste into an O(document) CRDT write broadcast to all collaborators — an amplification/integrity nuisance rather than an authorization bypass. The write path itself is correctly gated: `handlePaste` returns early when `this.readOnly` (line 1219) and the programmatic EditorAPI mutators are no-op'd in view-only mode (view/editor.ts:3667-3684), so no permission gate is weakened; only the blast radius per paste grows. I could not construct a privilege or data-disclosure consequence, hence low confidence.

samples.summary: New document-wide mutator `Doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll` is public on `Doc` and not covered by the view-only EditorAPI allowlist
samples.evidence: `dropStaleStyleOffAll` is added as a public method on `Doc` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts) that writes to every block in the document via `store.applyStyles`. The view-only gate is applied only at the EditorAPI boundary (view/editor.ts:3667-3684, MUTATING_METHODS allowlist), not on `Doc`. Today the only callers are `TextEditor.handlePaste` (readOnly-guarded, text-editor.ts:1219) and `afterNamedStyleChange` (reached only from the four allowlisted EditorAPI methods), so there is no live bypass; the risk is that a future caller of the now-public `Doc` method (or a holder of the `Doc` instance, e.g. the slides text-box editor which drives the same `Doc`) reaches a whole-document write with no read-only check. Grep of callers: `dropStaleStyleOffAll` appears only in document.ts, editor.ts, text-editor.ts and tests/docs.
